import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
credit_fraud = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a bar chart to show the distribution of transactions by type

plt.title('Distribution of Transactions by Type')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig('output2.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

plt.legend(title='Is Fraud')
